name: scheme-oracle
description: The migration bridge: anim-dump + dom-dump + reduced-dump prove a rewritten card's motion, structure and reduced path are byte-identical to the baseline. Never shipped, and it goes away at the end of stage 5 with the card migration it exists for. Needs a server: BASE=http://localhost:8888 npm run oracle (python3 -m http.server 8888 from the repo root); DEFAULT_BASE is :8080, the container, which serves a SNAPSHOT.
//: playwright is resolved from ../node_modules, the one install the whole sub-app shares. There is no node_modules here and there does not need to be.
//halves: THREE halves, and the catalogue-wide trio (oracle / oracle:base / oracle:diff) runs all three: the animated path alone left the ctx.reduced branch, where flowLights derives every guard, unwatched by anything that can fail. The per-card trio (oracle:card*) is deliberately the two animated halves, because it is the fast inner loop of a rewrite; oracle:card:reduced* is its third half and the migration procedure must run both.

scripts.oracle: node anim-dump.mjs --all --samples=0,10,25,50,75,90,100 --out=baselines/anim && node dom-dump.mjs --all --out=baselines/dom && node reduced-dump.mjs --all --out=baselines/reduced
scripts.oracle:base: node anim-dump.mjs --all --samples=0,10,25,50,75,90,100 --out=baselines/anim-base && node dom-dump.mjs --all --out=baselines/dom-base && node reduced-dump.mjs --all --out=baselines/reduced-base
scripts.oracle:diff: test -f baselines/anim/_complete && test -f baselines/dom/_complete && test -f baselines/reduced/_complete || { echo 'ORACLE INCOMPLETE: a run died partway, these dumps are not a full catalogue'; exit 1; }; diff -rq -x _complete baselines/anim-base baselines/anim && diff -rq -x _complete baselines/dom-base baselines/dom && diff -rq -x _complete baselines/reduced-base baselines/reduced && echo 'ORACLE CLEAN: motion, structure and the reduced path identical to the baseline'
scripts.oracle:card: sh -c 'test -n "$1" || { echo "usage: npm run oracle:card -- <scheme-id>"; exit 1; }; node anim-dump.mjs "$1" --samples=0,10,25,50,75,90,100 --out=baselines/anim && node dom-dump.mjs "$1" --out=baselines/dom' --
scripts.oracle:card:base: sh -c 'test -n "$1" || { echo "usage: npm run oracle:card:base -- <scheme-id>"; exit 1; }; node anim-dump.mjs "$1" --samples=0,10,25,50,75,90,100 --out=baselines/anim-base && node dom-dump.mjs "$1" --out=baselines/dom-base' --
scripts.oracle:card:diff: sh -c 'test -n "$1" || { echo "usage: npm run oracle:card:diff -- <scheme-id>"; exit 1; }; for f in baselines/anim-base/"$1".json baselines/anim/"$1".json baselines/dom-base/"$1".txt baselines/dom/"$1".txt; do test -f "$f" || { echo "MISSING $f: run oracle:card:base before the rewrite and oracle:card after"; exit 1; }; done; diff -u baselines/anim-base/"$1".json baselines/anim/"$1".json && diff -u baselines/dom-base/"$1".txt baselines/dom/"$1".txt && echo "CARD CLEAN: $1 motion and structure identical to the baseline" && echo "  ANIMATED PATH ONLY. The reduced guard is a separate half: npm run oracle:card:reduced:diff -- $1"' --
scripts.oracle:card:reduced: sh -c 'test -n "$1" || { echo "usage: npm run oracle:card:reduced -- <scheme-id>"; exit 1; }; node reduced-dump.mjs "$1" --out=baselines/reduced' --
scripts.oracle:card:reduced:base: sh -c 'test -n "$1" || { echo "usage: npm run oracle:card:reduced:base -- <scheme-id>"; exit 1; }; node reduced-dump.mjs "$1" --out=baselines/reduced-base' --
scripts.oracle:card:reduced:diff: sh -c 'test -n "$1" || { echo "usage: npm run oracle:card:reduced:diff -- <scheme-id>"; exit 1; }; for f in baselines/reduced-base/"$1".txt baselines/reduced/"$1".txt; do test -f "$f" || { echo "MISSING $f: run oracle:card:reduced:base before the rewrite and oracle:card:reduced after"; exit 1; }; done; diff -u baselines/reduced-base/"$1".txt baselines/reduced/"$1".txt && echo "CARD CLEAN (reduced): $1 prev, reset and deep-link state identical to the baseline"' --
